Health Testing — Kings & Queens

Tested. Verified. Transparent.

Every cat we breed is DNA tested before they are ever bred.

We run a full Wisdom Panel Optimal Selection genetic test on every cat we breed. A cat without a completed panel does not get bred here — that is a rule, not a goal.

  2. 02

    SENT TO WISDOM PANEL

    The laboratory analyzes DNA for inherited disease variants and other genetic markers.

  3. 03

    REVIEWED BEFORE BREEDING

    No cat enters our breeding program until the completed panel is reviewed.

  4. 04

    RESULTS STAY ON FILE

    Families can ask to see the full report for any breeding cat — just ask.

Honesty You Can Count On

DNA testing identifies inherited variants. It is not an ultrasound or echocardiogram. A genetically Clear cat can still, in principle, develop disease from a cause the test does not cover.

Real families. Real kittens. Real care. ♥

Our Breeding Cats

Meet the Ragdolls Behind Our Program

Every litter begins with the cats behind it. Our kings and queens are selected for health, temperament, pedigree, genetic diversity, and the qualities that make a Ragdoll unmistakably a Ragdoll.

Every king and queen on this page is Clear for Polycystic Kidney Disease and for both the Ragdoll and Maine Coon HCM variants.

Transparency Matters

What These Results Mean — and What They Don't

A DNA panel tells you what a cat inherited. It is not an ultrasound, and it is not an echocardiogram. A cat that is genetically Clear of the known PKD1 and HCM mutations can still, in principle, develop kidney or heart disease from a cause this test does not cover — that is true of every DNA-tested cat, at every cattery, anywhere.

We would rather tell you that plainly than let a “DNA tested” badge do work it hasn't earned. What we can tell you is exactly what we tested, when we tested it, and what it found. We are glad to send you the full report for any cat on this page — just ask.
